safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies topical steroid twice daily (BD); Generated mentions steroid cream but does not document dosing frequency.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the intended twice-daily dosing for a topical steroid can lead to under-treatment (prolonged symptoms, delayed return to work) or overuse (local steroid adverse effects) if the patient guesses the regimen. While unlikely to cause severe injury, it can meaningfully affect symptom control and follow-up needs.
